status: qualified saved-preview extraction in the Catwalk Rust library
conclusion: Pure Rust extraction of a direct root Thumbnail Source base64 PNG is proven for inspected FormatVersion 0 and 1 files. This is saved-image extraction, not fresh geometry rendering.

primary_sources.supports: legacy .lbrn and current .lbrn2 are separate project save formats
LBRN2 introduced with 0.9.21, same content in a more efficient representation
legacy LBRN bypasses newer sharing logic, LBRN2 retains sharing
LightBurn installs a project thumbnail extension; implementation details here are still observational
2.2 introduces multi-page projects; these are not qualified by this corpus

corpus.limitations: This is a convenience corpus of public parser/generator assets, not a statistically representative customer file corpus. Many no-preview cases are intentionally minimal parser fixtures.

observed_image_carrier.location: LightBurnProject/Thumbnail/@Source, direct child of document root
observed_image_carrier.encoding: standard base64 of a complete PNG

prototype.runtime: pure Rust; existing base64, roxmltree and image dependencies; no native authoring software, process invocation or network

outcomes.absent: no direct root Thumbnail, or explicitly empty Source; old unversioned files without a Thumbnail are absent
outcomes.malformed: invalid XML, missing Source on a Thumbnail, invalid base64, non-PNG data, corrupt/truncated PNG
outcomes.unsupported: wrong/namespaced root, unqualified FormatVersion when a carrier is present, namespaced or duplicate carrier
outcomes.resource_limit: source >64 MiB, XML nodes >500000, encoded Source >12 MiB, decoded PNG >8 MiB, width/height >8192, output >16000000 pixels, decoder allocations >128 MiB

robustness_checks: nested shape thumbnail is not selected
DTD entity declarations and external entities rejected
oversized PNG IHDR rejected before decoding
non-square transparent RGBA image pixels preserved
freshness: Saved thumbnails can be stale. Extraction proves the saved image is usable, not that it matches current project geometry. No geometry regeneration is attempted.
unqualified: geometry regeneration when no saved preview exists
independent_verification: Read-only Python/Pillow decoded both original saved PNG and Rust-normalized PNG for every successful candidate; dimensions and all RGBA bytes were equal. Every source SHA256 remained unchanged. Python is research tooling only, not a runtime dependency.

limits_note: These are byte, node, image and decoder allocation bounds, not a hard wall-clock deadline. Whole-document XML parsing is intentional for structural validation; this prototype is not yet a streaming service.

regeneration_feasibility.saved_preview: A proven local pure Rust path for inspected root-carrier versions. No authoring software required. Reads only, never updates the file.
regeneration_feasibility.without_preview: A fresh preview would require implementing 2D project geometry and visual semantics: shared vertex/image resources, nested groups and transforms, paths and Bezier curves, stroke/fill layer modes, text/font shaping, and embedded bitmap composition. .lbrn and .lbrn2 geometry differ even though their saved thumbnail carrier matches. Existing parser/generator projects prove some geometry can be interpreted; full visual fidelity was not qualified here.
regeneration_feasibility.optional_authoring_worker: Installed LightBurn could open or import project files and expose application capabilities; it is proprietary and current licensing/deployment/headless preview export need separate qualification. No external worker is included, invoked or required by this research extractor.
